tools.list.api: McpToolRegistryProvider.fromClient ToolRegistry, as the tools array of the provider request

progress.unsupported: McpTool.execute calls Client.callTool(name, arguments) with no RequestOptions.onProgress, so no progressToken is sent, and McpToolRegistryProvider takes no progress callback

logging.api: Client.setNotificationHandler(notifications/message) on the Kotlin SDK Client handed to McpToolRegistryProvider.fromClient; Koog registers no logging handler

cancellation.mechanism: cancelling the coroutine running AIAgent.run; McpTool.execute suspends in Client.callTool, which sends notifications/cancelled only when its own request timeout fires
cancellation.outcome: abandoned: Job.cancel() on the coroutine running AIAgent.run
